questionPdfs.title: class 9 based on ganita manjari
questionPdfs.subject: Mathematics
sampleQuestions: Sample Question 1 for ncert: Conceptual definitions and formula derivation.
Sample Question 2 for ncert: Graded computational problem with step-by-step evaluation.
Sample Question 3 for ncert: Higher-Order Thinking Skills (HOTS) challenge.

questionPdfs.title: Class 8 Mathematics Algebra Practice Set 1
questionPdfs.subject: Mathematics
questionPdfs.description: 25 carefully curated problems on algebraic multiplication, identity verification, and common factoring patterns.
sampleQuestions: Expand: (2x + 3y)(2x - 3y) using standard identities.
Factorise completely: 49x² - 64y².
If x + 1/x = 5, find the value of x² + 1/x².
Simplify: (a + b)² - (a - b)² and show the resulting monomial.

questionPdfs.title: Class 10 Quadratic Equations Board Booster Set
questionPdfs.subject: Mathematics
questionPdfs.topic: Discriminant, Nature of Roots & Word Problems
questionPdfs.description: Selected 20 Board Exam standard questions covering train speed problems, time-and-work, and quadratic formula proofs.
sampleQuestions: Find the values of k for which the quadratic equation (k + 1)x² - 2(k - 1)x + 1 = 0 has real and equal roots.

An express train takes 1 hour less than a passenger train to travel 132 km between Mysore and Bangalore. If the average speed of the express train is 11 km/h more than that of the passenger train, find their average speeds.

questionPdfs.title: Class 9 Triangles & Congruence Criteria Mastery Test
questionPdfs.subject: Mathematics
questionPdfs.topic: SAS, ASA, SSS, RHS Congruence Theorems & Inequalities
questionPdfs.description: Comprehensive set of geometry proof questions with clear figure references and structured proof steps.
sampleQuestions: In an isosceles triangle ABC with AB = AC, D and E are points on BC such that BE = CD. Show that AD = AE.
State and prove the ASA congruence rule from basic geometric axioms.
In right triangle ABC, right angled at C, M is the midpoint of hypotenuse AB. Show that CM = 1/2 AB.

questionPdfs.title: Class 12 Continuity & Differentiability High-Score Bank
questionPdfs.subject: Mathematics
questionPdfs.topic: Chain Rule, Parametric Differentiation & Rolle’s Theorem
questionPdfs.description: High-scoring questions with detailed evaluation marking schemes for 12th CBSE/State board aspirants.
sampleQuestions: If y = (sin⁻¹ x)², prove that (1 - x²) (d²y/dx²) - x (dy/dx) - 2 = 0.
Find dy/dx when x = a(θ - sin θ) and y = a(1 + cos θ) at θ = π/2.
Determine the values of a and b such that the function f(x) is continuous everywhere.

questionPdfs.title: Class 7 Fractions, Decimals & Integers Olympiad Drill
questionPdfs.subject: Mathematics
questionPdfs.description: Analytical non-routine problems challenging young students to build speed and intuitive mental calculations.
sampleQuestions: A rectangular sheet of paper is 12 1/2 cm long and 10 2/3 cm wide. Find its perimeter and area in simplest mixed fractions.
Evaluate: [(-36) ÷ 12] ÷ 3 and compare with (-36) ÷ [12 ÷ 3]. Explain why division is not associative.

questionPdfs.title: Class 10 Arithmetic Progressions (AP) Speed Drills
questionPdfs.subject: Mathematics
questionPdfs.topic: nth Term & Sum of n Terms Formulas
questionPdfs.description: Quick 15-question sprint paper to master the nth term formula and sum of n terms with instant calculations.
sampleQuestions: Find the 20th term from the last term of the AP: 3, 8, 13, ..., 253.
If the sum of the first n terms of an AP is given by Sn = 3n² + 5n, find its nth term.
